regional_compliance.tax_context: Standard federal and state income/payroll tax; some states offer childcare-specific tax credits or subsidies for providers serving low-income families.
regional_compliance.labor_regulation: Child-to-staff ratios are set at the state level and vary significantly — no single federal standard, meaning compliance requirements differ depending on state of operation.
regional_compliance.licensing_bodies: State department of health and human services (or equivalent) issues childcare licenses; requirements for background checks, facility inspections, and staff certifications vary by state.
